regenerate_confirm: Regenerating the CA invalidates every certificate issued so far. Already-visited HTTPS sites will need a fresh handshake. Continue?
ca_description: Root certificate used to intercept HTTPS traffic. Install it in the browser or system you'll use for testing so you can browse without certificate warnings.
auto_install_description: Via the backend's command line, using the same <0>{{pkg}}</0> Hetty uses:
auto_install_note: Installs into the system trust store (may prompt for your password). To undo it, use <0>cert uninstall</0>.
no_install_description: Opens a throwaway Chrome profile already configured with the proxy, ignoring certificate warnings: the same technique Burp Suite and Hetty (<0>--chrome</0>) use. Nothing is saved between runs, and your real Chrome profile is never touched.
